summary: Operator is Big Prairie Township (the township's Oxbow Park page gives 2973 Cottonwood Ave, Newaygo, phone (231) 856-4279, matching the entry); it says nothing else. Fees ($35-40 RV base, $6 reservation surcharge), 50-amp, season and the 197-site count stand from the 2026-10-13 Campspot read, which offers every RV type to motorhomes. Booking url set to the operator's campspot.com/book link. The township's old parks domain (bigprairietownshipparks.com, named on Campspot) no longer resolves. Not long-stay in character: Campspot sells 132 RV sites nightly (70 back-in, 36 pull-through, 25 water-view, 1 ADA) of the 197.
